name: Kambiz Divsalar
bio: Kambiz is a master of science researcher with a strong academic background in thermal engineering, heat transfer, and energy systems. His research interests focus on battery thermal management, advanced cooling technologies, and the thermal performance optimization of energy storage systems. His research experience includes developing and validating a numerical battery model using the NTGK method to accurately predict heat generation during charging and discharging, as well as investigating bio-inspired fin structures and phase change materials to enhance heat transfer and improve battery thermal regulation. He is particularly interested in combining computational modeling, numerical simulation, and experimental validation to develop efficient and sustainable thermal management solutions. His long-term academic goal is to pursue doctoral research in thermal energy engineering and contribute to the advancement of innovative technologies for sustainable energy systems.

name: Professor Alibakhsh Kasaeian
bio: Alibakhsh Kasaeian is a Full Professor at the University of Tehran and serves as the Head of the KASA Lab. He is consistently recognized among the world's top 2% of scientists, having been included in Stanford University's prestigious list for multiple consecutive years (from 2021 to 2025). His research interests encompass solar thermal and photovoltaic systems, nanofluid flow and heat transfer, thermodynamic and exergetic analyses of power and cooling systems, hybrid renewable energy systems, solar-powered water purification and desalination, building energy optimization, and hydrogen production.
